the FNV1 algorithm is the best choice for searching for duplicates in shared memory, data parallel environments.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have developed the Hash-Fight data-parallel duplicate search algorithm and demonstrated that it performs well on a variety of architectures and data sets.

the choice of algorithm and hash functions are important and can significantly affect the performance of data-parallel searching.
